newsitem.title: USA: Mich. school district may seek $580 mln of bonds.
newsitem.headline: Mich. school district may seek $580 mln of bonds.

text.p: A citizens committee for the Grand Rapids public schools has recommended asking residents to approve $580 million of bonds next year for a building repair and replacement program.
The committee recommendations unveiled Monday must next go to the superintendent for review and ultimately be approved by the school board.
About 85 school buildings would receive improvements through the program, which would also include replacing a school built in 1875 and using the historical landmark for other purposes.
The bond election would be held in February or March under the recommendations and the bonds would be sold over a six or eight year period.
